releaseNotes: NEW: every editing category now has its own premium thumbnail - Formula = Eiffel Tower, Transition = Taj Mahal, Motion = Burj Khalifa, Effects = neon light art
Formula, Motion, Transition and Effect cards now show real category imagery instead of generated placeholders, while still animating the actual motion/effect on top
Extracted video frames now save to Pictures/AutoEdit/Frames so they are grouped and easy to find in Gallery
Play Video no longer dead-ends when no default player is set - you get a chooser plus Share
All assets are bundled locally, so the app stays fully offline
Export fix from 1.3.1 kept: no more freeze on 'Finalizing...', real error messages, verified MP4 before 'Export Complete'
